name: Onna Bushi Matsuba
source:
One by one, various spirits populated a town where humans lived, until the town was
almost all spirits, who merged theirs with the human world of business. Now, there lived a lazy and
poor frog spirit, Keroyoshi, who spent his days loafing around.
But as a business of the human world, the frog could not escape taxation.
The tax collector came. She was Matsuba, a young female samurai.
Keroyoshi decided then he would raise the money to pay somehow... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083825.html]DLsite[/url]]
